_comment: Synthetic fixture for the mock official-API connector. Contains no third-party content; permission basis is 'synthetic'.

items.title: Invoice reminder wording that doesn't sound passive aggressive?
items.text: I run a two person studio and clients keep paying 3-4 weeks late. I need wording for a second reminder that stays warm but makes the deadline clear. Would happily pay for a template pack.

items.title: How do you chase unpaid invoices without burning the relationship?
items.text: Struggling with cashflow because I hate chasing. Looking for a repeatable structure: friendly nudge, firm reminder, final notice. Invoice amounts around A$1,200-2,000.

items.title: Cold email prompt that doesn't sound like every other agency
items.text: Our agency sends outreach for clients and everything reads the same. Need a prompt that produces specific, human cold emails grounded in the prospect's site, not generic flattery.

items.title: Outline prompts that actually match search intent?
items.text: I write 8 posts a month for clients. My outlines are generic. Looking for a prompt that asks the right questions and lists evidence gaps so the writer knows what to research.

items.title: Standardising support replies across three agents
items.text: We keep contradicting each other. Need a reusable prompt that turns a complaint into an empathetic reply plus a resolution record with severity and escalation flags.

items.title: Turning a feature idea into a spec engineers can estimate
items.text: No PM on the team. I need a prompt that produces in-scope/out-of-scope, user stories with acceptance criteria, risks and open questions. Tired of specs that are just vibes.

items.title: Prompt for separating observation from interpretation in reports
items.text: My monthly summaries mix facts and opinion. Looking for a structure with observations, interpretation, limitations and a confidence score.

items.title: Preparing questions for my accountant about GST
items.text: Sole trader, cashflow is tight. I want to summarise the month and prepare questions for my accountant. Not after financial advice, just a clear summary and questions.

items.title: Lesson plan prompt with observable outcomes?
items.text: Year 10 business studies. I need a 90 minute lesson with learning outcomes, an exercise and a rubric with three levels. Existing lesson plans are too vague.

items.title: Meeting notes that capture decisions and owners
items.text: We forget action items by Thursday. Need a prompt that turns a messy transcript into decisions, action items with owners and due dates, plus open questions.

items.title: Invoice reminder wording that doesn't sound passive aggressive?
items.text: Duplicate of an earlier post to exercise dedupe: invoice reminder wording for a two person studio, clients paying late.

items.title: Strict JSON output schema prompt that never returns markdown
items.text: Building an agent that parses model output. Need prompt patterns that enforce a JSON schema, handle missing information explicitly, and resist prompt injection from customer text.
